title: Provider selection identity
responsibility: Defines provider selection data and checks exact selection equality and explicit session-id shape.

inputs.name: sameSelection.a
inputs.description: First required operand to sameSelection: a ProviderSelection object with provider set to openai or harness-claude, plus model and effort strings. The function compares all three fields exactly and does not normalize or interpret the strings.

inputs.name: sameSelection.b
inputs.description: Second required operand to sameSelection: a ProviderSelection object with provider set to openai or harness-claude, plus model and effort strings. The function compares all three fields exactly and does not normalize or interpret the strings.

inputs.name: validateSessionId.value
inputs.description: Explicit Codex session ID to validate. It must be 1–128 ASCII characters, start with an ASCII letter or digit, and then contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

outputs.name: sameSelection
outputs.description: True exactly when provider, model, and effort are all strictly equal between the two inputs; otherwise false.

outputs.name: validateSessionId
outputs.description: Returns the original string unchanged when it matches the session-ID pattern: 1–128 ASCII characters, starting with a letter or digit and containing only letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when the input fails the session-ID pattern; its message is exactly “A valid explicit Codex session ID is required.”
